then.description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills. See the Rogue Starting Move, **Tricks of the Trade**.

else.description: You don't have the **Tricks of the Trade** Rogue Starting Move, so you gain it, but only with these two Skills. If you already had any of these Roguish Skills, work with the GM to create a new one for each redundant Skill.

submoves.title: Tricks of the Trade
submoves.description: When you **Defy Danger** or **Sneak Past** by applying one of your Roguish Skills, you cheat; roll with 1d8+1d6 (instead of 2d6).

submoves.title: Nose for Treasure
submoves.description: When you **Unearth Secrets**, no matter the outcome of the roll, you may also ask, Are there valuables here I don't know about? If yes, gain **adv** on the next roll to pursue them.

title: Better Lucky Than Good
description: When you take this Move you get Luck equal to your WIS (min 1). When you **Defy Danger** or **Trade Blows**, on a 7-9, you can mark Luck instead of the other options.

outcomes.text: When you **Enjoy Downtime**, you can spend 1 Treasure helping an NPC(s) to regain Luck equal to your WIS (min 1).

title: Breaking & Entering
description: When you **set your mind to steal something**, name the thing and ask the GM questions equal to your WIS (min 1) and they will answer truthfully. When you acquire it, you and everyone who helped each clear a **Condition**:

bullets: What's the best way in or out?
What else am I missing regarding it?

title: Quick on the Draw
description: When the GM or another Player is about to make a Move, with their permission (out of character) you can mark a Condition to interrupt it and act immediately instead.

title: Vanishing Act
description: When you **are sure no one is paying attention directly to you**, you can disappear from a Scene entirely, not rejoining the narrative until the Scene ends. If you're in trouble or a bind, ask the GM what you must do to disappear and they will tell you up to (4 - WIS) of the following requirements:

bullets: When you reappear, it will come with trouble
You must leave something significant behind
You must mark a Condition in the process
